digest.component_or_area: LLM model class routing and configuration
propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-call sites pass `config=cfg` without declaring a model class, causing them to inherit `cfg.model` (direct Anthropic) instead of respecting the model-class configuration table.
The overlap-judge sub-call dominates plan-review traffic (18 of 23 calls) and sends all requests to direct Anthropic when a Bedrock model class is configured, bypassing the intended provider.

The ticket-digest sub-call runs on the store write path without gate invocation, sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during routine `rebar comment`/`create` calls with no visibility in verdicts.
A regression test must configure model classes that differ from `cfg.model` to distinguish between calls that inherit the raw config (defect) and calls that honor the class vocabulary (correct).

Hand-built sub-calls must select their model from the class vocabulary with explicit reasoning, except for top-level ops' primary calls which legitimately use `cfg.model` as the operator's control knob.
